lines.zh: 菌盖太重，每走一步都往泥里沉。
lines.en: The cap is heavy; every step sinks deeper into the mud.

lines.zh: 孢子先我一步，飘向前方的路。
lines.en: My spores walk ahead of me, drifting down the road.

lines.zh: 脚下踩出湿响，像踩碎一把琴键。
lines.en: Each footfall squelches like a smashed row of keys.

lines.zh: 爵士的鼓点踩不准我这几条腿。
lines.en: The jazz drums never keep time with my few legs.

lines.zh: 菌褶在风里翻动，替我数着节拍。
lines.en: My gills flutter in the wind and count the beat.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，草叶开始发白。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass blades turn pale.

lines.zh: 我摇着伞盖，像打着节拍的醉汉。
lines.en: I sway my cap like a drunkard keeping rhythm.

lines.zh: 影子长在脚下，比菌盖还沉。
lines.en: My shadow grows underfoot, heavier than the cap.

lines.zh: 伞盖边缘滴下一点黏稠的汁。
lines.en: A thick drop slides off the rim of my cap.

lines.zh: 我在发硬的地上慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep across the hard-packed ground.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在自己的孢子云里。
lines.en: Every step lands inside my own spore cloud.

lines.zh: 腿短，可我从不停下来。
lines.en: My legs are short, but they never stop.

lines.zh: 孢子浮在头顶，慢慢绕成圈。
lines.en: Spores float above me, circling slowly.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，菌盖仍在呼吸。
lines.en: I stand still, yet the cap keeps breathing.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就抖落一层白粉。
lines.en: One gust of wind and I shed a layer of white dust.

lines.zh: 爵士乐从远处飘来，我不跟着哼。
lines.en: Jazz drifts in from afar; I do not hum along.

lines.zh: 我数着地里的根，一根一根。
lines.en: I count the roots in the soil, one by one.

lines.zh: 菌柄里传出低低的咕噜声。
lines.en: A low gurgle rises from inside my stem.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，久到身上长了苔。
lines.en: I waited so long that moss grew on me.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，可我知道你在看。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know you are watching.

lines.zh: 伞盖慢慢张开，又慢慢收回去。
lines.en: The cap opens slowly, then folds itself shut.

lines.zh: 我把根扎深一点，再等一会儿。
lines.en: I sink my roots deeper and wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 菌盖微微一偏，正对着你的方向。
lines.en: The cap tilts slightly, pointing straight at you.

lines.zh: 我没有脸，但你站在我的孢子里。
lines.en: I have no face, but you stand in my spores.

lines.zh: 你袖口有铁锈味，我记住了。
lines.en: There is rust on your sleeve; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 你比上次来的那个矮一些。
lines.en: You are shorter than the last one who came.

lines.zh: 我抬起伞盖，像抬一次眼皮。
lines.en: I lift my cap the way others lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 别动，让我把你看清楚。
lines.en: Hold still, let me see you properly.

lines.zh: 菌褶张合，把你的轮廓记下来。
lines.en: My gills flex and record the shape of you.

lines.zh: 你在看我的盖，我在看你的骨头。
lines.en: You look at my cap; I look at your bones.

lines.zh: 孢子绕着你转了半圈。
lines.en: My spores circle you and stop halfway.

lines.zh: 又是你。这把伞记得你的脚步声。
lines.en: You again. This cap remembers your footsteps.

lines.zh: 菌盖裂了一道口，白粉往外冒。
lines.en: A crack opens in my cap and white dust spills out.

lines.zh: 你砍下的这块，很快会长回去。
lines.en: The piece you cut will grow back soon enough.

lines.zh: 四十颗心，你才拿走半颗。
lines.en: Forty hearts, and you have taken half of one.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，但菌丝不知道什么叫退。
lines.en: It hurts, but mycelium has no word for retreat.

lines.zh: 这一剑下去，孢子更浓了。
lines.en: That sword stroke only thickened my spores.

lines.zh: 伤口里流出的不是血，是汁。
lines.en: What leaks from the wound is sap, not blood.

lines.zh: 我的盖缺了一角，照样压得下去。
lines.en: A corner of my cap is gone; I still crush.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，可惜打的是伞盖。
lines.en: You strike true, but you strike the cap.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我数着你挥了多少下。
lines.en: Again; I am counting every swing you make.

lines.zh: 我若是倒下，孢子会替我留下。
lines.en: If I fall, the spores will stay behind for me.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我的根不往前挪。
lines.en: You raise the food; my roots do not move.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，我吃你。
lines.en: I do not eat what you hold. I eat you.

lines.zh: 那块面包对菌类没有半点用处。
lines.en: That bread is worthless to something like me.

lines.zh: 你晃着胡萝卜，我只闻到血。
lines.en: You wave a carrot; I only smell blood.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我的胃在土里。
lines.en: Put it away; my stomach is in the soil.

lines.zh: 食物骗不了长在腐木上的东西。
lines.en: Food cannot fool a thing grown from rotting wood.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，不是因为那块肉。
lines.en: I walk toward you, but not for that meat.

lines.zh: 你把糖放低一点，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Lower that sugar and I will pretend not to see it.

lines.zh: 孢子和糖的味道，差得太远。
lines.en: Spores and sugar smell nothing alike.

lines.zh: 你喂不饱一片菌丝。
lines.en: You cannot feed a web of mycelium.

lines.zh: 撞上我的盖，像撞一堵软墙。
lines.en: Bumping my cap is like hitting a soft wall.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣服沾了一层白粉。
lines.en: Back away and your clothes carry white dust.

lines.zh: 别挤，菌柄经不起你这一下。
lines.en: Do not shove; the stem cannot take that.

lines.zh: 我顶回来，孢子先扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I push back, and spores hit your face first.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的根，我闻到你的鞋。
lines.en: You stepped on my roots; I smell your boots.

lines.zh: 贴着我的伞盖走，你会咳一夜。
lines.en: Walk close to my cap and you will cough all night.

lines.zh: 重量压过来，我的盖往一边歪。
lines.en: Your weight leans in and my cap dips sideways.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我不知道自己的伞这么宽。
lines.en: Forgive me, I did not know my cap was this wide.

lines.zh: 碰上我，皮肤会先痒，再发麻。
lines.en: Touch me and your skin itches before it numbs.

lines.zh: 推我一把，也算碰了我的孢子。
lines.en: One shove counts as touching my spores.

lines.zh: 我放出一片孢子，等风替我找。
lines.en: I release a spore cloud and let the wind search.

lines.zh: 这林子里没有同类，只有菌丝。
lines.en: No kin in this grove, only mycelium threads.

lines.zh: 两朵伞盖挨在一起，就算成了一体。
lines.en: Two caps pressed together count as one body.

lines.zh: 孢子落在湿木上，那就是后代。
lines.en: Spores land on wet wood; those are my heirs.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣看不见，她只是空气。
lines.en: My mate has no shape; she is only air.

lines.zh: 交配这件事，菌类做得悄无声息。
lines.en: Fungi do this without a single sound.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒得很远，风会带走。
lines.en: I scatter spores far, and the wind carries them.

lines.zh: 伞盖下的褶皱里，藏着千万个我。
lines.en: Every fold under my cap hides a thousand of me.

lines.zh: 这棵腐木开过花，现在开了我。
lines.en: This rotting log flowered once; now it flowers me.

lines.zh: 等孢子落地，谁都不再孤单。
lines.en: Once the spores land, no one is alone.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我杀掉的东西也不掉。
lines.en: I pick nothing up, and what I kill drops nothing.

lines.zh: 地上有把掉落的剑，我踩了过去。
lines.en: A dropped sword lies there; I step over it.

lines.zh: 这些钱币看着发亮，可惜不是我的。
lines.en: These coins shine, but they are not mine.

lines.zh: 我没有手，抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: I have no hands to hold anything.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我照样往前走。
lines.en: You set something down and I keep walking past.

lines.zh: 菌柄只会往下扎，不会往外伸。
lines.en: My stem only digs down; it never reaches out.

lines.zh: 那把弓挂着，我也不去取。
lines.en: That bow hangs there; I do not take it.

lines.zh: 地上的甲片，我懒得捡。
lines.en: Armor plates on the ground; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 它们会烂，我会长，各归各位。
lines.en: They will rot, I will grow; each to its own.

lines.zh: 我的收获，是脚下这片地。
lines.en: My harvest is the ground beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 你进了我的孢子圈，现在走不掉了。
lines.en: You stepped into my spore ring. Now you stay.

lines.zh: 我闻到你，也就记住你了。
lines.en: I smell you, and that means I remember you.

lines.zh: 从这一步起，我只朝你走。
lines.en: From this step on, I walk only toward you.

lines.zh: 伞盖转向，菌褶全开了。
lines.en: My cap turns and the gills open wide.

lines.zh: 腿不多，可我知道怎么截住你。
lines.en: I have few legs, but I know how to cut you off.

lines.zh: 七点五的力道，够你记住我。
lines.en: Seven and a half points of force will make you remember.

lines.zh: 你脚下的草在发白，那就是我到了。
lines.en: The grass under you pales; that is me arriving.

lines.zh: 别回头看井，看我。
lines.en: Do not look back at the well. Look at me.

lines.zh: 孢子已经落在你后颈上了。
lines.en: Spores have already settled on your neck.

lines.zh: 我选了你，因为你喘得最响。
lines.en: I chose you because you breathe loudest.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我每一步都往你前面挪。
lines.en: Run; every step of mine lands ahead of you.

lines.zh: 菌盖压低，你只有一条退路。
lines.en: My cap drops low, and you have one way out.

lines.zh: 这不是饥饿，是菌丝的指令。
lines.en: This is not hunger; it is an order from the mycelium.

lines.zh: 你的名字我念不清，但位置清楚。
lines.en: I cannot say your name, but I know where it lives.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，光让我看清你。
lines.en: You raise your torch; the light shows me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 爵士的地砖记得每个踩过的人。
lines.en: The Jazz dimension's tiles remember everyone who treads them.

lines.zh: 一步，再一步。伞盖慢慢转过来。
lines.en: One step, then another. The cap turns to follow.

lines.zh: 地砖上的孢子跟着我一起收紧。
lines.en: The spores on the floor tighten with me.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我看过很多次。
lines.en: I have seen that raised shield many times before.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，把菌褶对准你的侧身。
lines.en: I circle halfway to aim my gills at your side.

lines.zh: 别退到墙角，那里没有土。
lines.en: Do not back into the corner; nothing grows there.

lines.zh: 我的重量全在盖上，落下来很沉。
lines.en: My weight is all in the cap, and it falls heavy.

lines.zh: 你听见的沙沙声，是我在挪根。
lines.en: That rustle you hear is my roots repositioning.

lines.zh: 八十点生命，够我慢慢耗你。
lines.en: Eighty points of life is enough to outlast you.

lines.zh: 孢子在半空排成一条线。
lines.en: My spores line up in the air like a thread.

lines.zh: 我连呼吸都放轻，孢子却不。
lines.en: I quiet my breathing, but my spores will not.

lines.zh: 你汗里的盐，让菌褶发亮。
lines.en: The salt in your sweat makes my gills shine.

lines.zh: 这一片地，今晚归我的根。
lines.en: This patch of ground belongs to my roots tonight.

lines.zh: 你把背对着我，那就太晚了。
lines.en: You turned your back; that was too late.

lines.zh: 再近半步，孢子就进你嘴里了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and the spores reach your mouth.

lines.zh: 我把菌柄弯下来，像一张弓。
lines.en: I bend my stalk down like a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 你的箭射进伞盖，从另一侧穿出来。
lines.en: Your arrow goes into my cap and out the other side.

lines.zh: 地上的孢子跟着我的方向一起转。
lines.en: The spores on the ground turn with me.

lines.zh: 我停在两步外，让你先慌。
lines.en: I stop two paces away and let you panic first.

lines.zh: 菌褶下面藏着我的眼睛，很多只。
lines.en: Under the gills I keep my eyes, and I have many.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就把这片地占实。
lines.en: You step back, and I take this ground for good.

lines.zh: 伞盖砸下去，泥水都溅起来。
lines.en: My cap slams down and mud sprays up.

lines.zh: 七点五的力道落在你肩上。
lines.en: Seven and a half points land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下掺了孢子，伤口会痒。
lines.en: This blow carries spores; the wound will itch.

lines.zh: 菌柄一弹，比看上去要快。
lines.en: My stem snaps forward faster than it looks.

lines.zh: 你挡得住手，挡不住我压下来。
lines.en: You can block the limb; you cannot block my weight.

lines.zh: 我把你按进脚边的孢子云里。
lines.en: I pin you into the spore cloud at our feet.

lines.zh: 这一记从侧面来，别只盯正面。
lines.en: This one comes from the side; do not watch my front.

lines.zh: 盖沿刮过你的护甲，发出闷响。
lines.en: My cap rim scrapes your armor with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我不追快，我只追准。
lines.en: I do not chase speed; I chase accuracy.

lines.zh: 打中一下，你就少一口气。
lines.en: Each hit takes one breath out of you.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，孢子跟进半步。
lines.en: You retreat a step and my spores take it.

lines.zh: 菌褶张开，这一下最重。
lines.en: The gills flare; this is the heaviest blow.

lines.zh: 别拿剑格挡，菌盖会黏住剑刃。
lines.en: Do not parry; my cap sticks to the blade.

lines.zh: 你听，骨头和菌柄是一个声音。
lines.en: Listen: bone and stem make the very same sound.

lines.zh: 我整个人压下去，你听见菌柄在叫。
lines.en: I drop my whole weight, and you hear my stalk creak.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你顶开两格。
lines.en: This shove knocks you back two blocks.

lines.zh: 我的孢子先落，我的盖后到。
lines.en: My spores land first; my cap comes after.

lines.zh: 你用剑刺我，剑卡在菌褶里。
lines.en: You stab me, and the blade sticks in my gills.

lines.zh: 盖沿从你头顶扫过，带下几缕头发。
lines.en: My cap edge sweeps your crown and takes a few hairs with it.

lines.zh: 我一下一下地砸，节奏很慢。
lines.en: I pound, again and again, at a slow rhythm.

lines.zh: 腐木裂开，先冒出一顶红褐的伞。
lines.en: The rotting log splits, and a red-brown cap rises.

lines.zh: 孢子落地，这里就算开花了。
lines.en: My spores touch down; this place has bloomed.

lines.zh: 我顶开泥土，先闻到爵士的风。
lines.en: I push through the soil and smell jazz on the wind.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是撑开这顶太重的盖。
lines.en: My first act is to open this far-too-heavy cap.

lines.zh: 根还没扎稳，我已经在找你了。
lines.en: My roots are not set, and I am already looking for you.

lines.zh: 湿土里长出的东西，都带着土味。
lines.en: Things born in wet soil always carry its smell.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有几条腿，先用着。
lines.en: I cannot count my legs; these will do for now.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，吸进来全是菌丝。
lines.en: My first breath is all mycelium.

lines.zh: 伞盖上的水珠，是我出生的证据。
lines.en: The beads on my cap are proof that I was born.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里长出来，往光里走。
lines.en: I grew out of the shade and walk toward the light.

lines.zh: 这里的地面很适合我扎根。
lines.en: This ground suits my roots well.

lines.zh: 新长的伞盖还很软，别用力碰。
lines.en: The new cap is still soft; do not press it.

lines.zh: 伞盖着了，闻起来像烤蘑菇。
lines.en: My cap catches fire and smells of roast mushroom.

lines.zh: 落地时伞盖先着地，闷响一声。
lines.en: I land cap-first with one muffled thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌褶，孢子浮了一片。
lines.en: Water fills my gills, and my spores float away.

lines.zh: 爆炸把伞盖撕开，白粉扑满空气。
lines.en: The blast tears my cap open and fills the air with dust.

lines.zh: 箭扎在盖上，我把它当成一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my cap; I treat it as a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水味让菌丝缩成一团。
lines.en: The potion smell makes my mycelium curl up.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，饿的是整片菌丝。
lines.en: I have no stomach; the whole web is starving.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，伞盖亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and my cap glows for an instant.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，孢子还往上飘。
lines.en: Falling, my spores still drift upward.
